cnTitle: 流年太岁值年怎么看：一年主权在自己手里，也最怕硬碰
enTitle: When Tai Sui Presides Over Your Year: Authority in Hand, but Clashes Cost Most
enDesc: A Tai Sui year brings initiative, opportunities and changes, but it favors steadiness and punishes head-on clashes; pushing too hard can turn an opening into a deadlock, so advance steadily.
cnDesc: 太岁值年主这一年主动性强、机遇与变动都多，但太岁喜稳忌冲，逢刑冲硬碰容易把好事变成僵局，宜稳中求进。

cnTitle: 流年青龙怎么看：财喜、贵人与顺遂，但不是躺着就来
enTitle: When Qing Long Appears: Wealth, Joy and Helpers, Not a Free Pass
enDesc: Qing Long brings financial joy, helpful people and smoother progress, but the auspicious signs must be met with action; if malefics, obstructions or passivity enter, the benefit is discounted.
cnDesc: 青龙主财喜、贵人与事业顺遂，这一年机会比平时顺，但吉象要靠行动接住，若逢煞忌或自己不动，好处也会打折。

cnTitle: 流年小耗怎么看：琐碎漏财不伤根本，管的是习惯
enTitle: When Xiao Hao Appears: Small Leaks That Do Not Break You, But Test Your Habits
enDesc: Xiao Hao governs small, scattered expenses and minor plan delays that never break the foundation but can add up; the year focus is budgeting, plugging small leaks and keeping a buffer.
cnDesc: 小耗主小额、琐碎的开销与计划小阻，不伤根本，却容易积少成多；这一年重点是做预算、堵小缝、留缓冲。

cnTitle: 流年朱雀怎么看：口舌是非多，把话写清楚就少一半
enTitle: When Zhu Que Appears: Disputes and Rumor; Clear Words Remove Half the Trouble
enDesc: Zhu Que governs disputes, rumor, paperwork arguments and careless speech, bringing more misunderstandings than usual; clarify first, keep written records and use proper channels to avoid most trouble.
cnDesc: 朱雀主口舌、是非、文书争执与表达失当，这一年误会比平时多；凡事先说清、留书面、走正规途径，能避开大半风波。

cnTitle: 流年五鬼怎么看：暗耗与临门生变，靠核对和余地化解
enTitle: When Wu Gui Appears: Hidden Drain and Last-Minute Changes, Resolved by Checking and Margin
enDesc: Wu Gui governs hidden drain, blockages, last-minute changes and quiet interference, with surprises coming from unseen places; double-check, keep backups and leave margin to minimize the hidden cost.
cnDesc: 五鬼主暗耗、阻滞、计划临门生变与小人暗扰，这一年意外多在看不见处；多核对、留备份、给计划留余地，能把暗耗降到最低。

cnTitle: 流年死符怎么看：小灾与停顿，宜缓行排查而非硬闯
enTitle: When Si Fu Appears: Minor Mishaps and Pauses; Slow Down and Inspect Rather Than Push Through
enDesc: Si Fu governs minor mishaps, pauses and the closing of old matters; this is not a year to force ahead. Inspect for risks early, take small health signs seriously and leave margin to avoid most trouble.
cnDesc: 死符主小灾、停顿与旧事收尾，这一年不宜硬闯冒进；把隐患排查在前、身体小信号当回事、大事留余地，多数风波能避开。

cnTitle: 流年力士怎么看：执行力与辅佐，把主张稳稳落地
enTitle: When Li Shi Appears: Execution and Support That Carry Your Plans Through
enDesc: Li Shi rises with Tai Sui, governing execution, support and carrying plans through; your ability to get things done is strong this year. Direct that energy at a settled direction and guard against overexertion and doing everything yourself.
cnDesc: 力士随太岁而起，主执行力、辅佐与把主张落地，这一年动手能力强；关键是把力气用在已定的方向上，防用力过猛、事必躬亲。

cnTitle: 流年奏书怎么看：文书呈报与功名，利递交申请与发表
enTitle: When Zou Shu Appears: Documents, Petitions and Academic Credit; Favoring Applications and Publication
enDesc: Zou Shu governs documents, petitions, academic credit and applications, favoring submissions, filings, exams and public expression; the key is well-prepared materials and accurate deadlines so what must be filed is filed on time.
cnDesc: 奏书主文书、呈报、功名与申请，这一年利递交、申报、考试与公开发表；关键是材料规范、节点抓准，把该交的东西按时交到位。

cnTitle: 2026天同化禄在命宫：福气回到自己身上，也别只图舒服
enTitle: 2026 Tian Tong Hua Lu in the Life Palace: Goodwill Flows Back to You, Just Do Not Settle for Comfort Alone
enDesc: With Tian Tong Hua Lu in the Life Palace, the year brings goodwill, connections and smoother openings along with an easier mood; turn that goodwill into accumulation and guard against chasing comfort while what should move gets delayed.
cnDesc: 天同化禄落命宫，这一年被善待、人缘与机会都比平时顺，心情也松；关键是把福气转成积累，防只顾当下舒服、该推进的事被拖过去。

cnTitle: 2026天同化禄在财帛宫：轻松得财、人情生财，也要留得住
enTitle: 2026 Tian Tong Hua Lu in the Wealth Palace: Easier, People-Based Income That You Still Must Keep
enDesc: With Tian Tong Hua Lu in the Wealth Palace, money arrives more easily and connections can generate income, often through service, warmth and cooperation; keep what arrives and turn it into savings rather than spending it freely. This is not investment advice.
cnDesc: 天同化禄落财帛，这一年钱来得相对轻松、人缘能生财，机会多在服务、人情与合作上；关键是把到手的钱留住、转成储蓄，防随手花掉（不构成投资建议）。

cnTitle: 2026天同化禄在官禄宫：工作气氛缓和，利协调服务，防躺平
enTitle: 2026 Tian Tong Hua Lu in the Career Palace: A Gentler Workplace Favoring Coordination, While Guarding Against Checking Out
enDesc: With Tian Tong Hua Lu in the Career Palace, work relationships ease and coordination, service and people-focused roles benefit with less conflict; use the smooth period to deliver and secure your position, guarding against seeking ease so much that you stop advancing.
cnDesc: 天同化禄落官禄，这一年工作关系缓和、利协调、服务与人情型岗位，冲突少；关键是借顺境把事做成、把位置坐稳，防一味求轻松而不上进。

cnTitle: 2026天同化禄在福德宫：精神放松、利睡眠情绪，防沉溺安逸
enTitle: 2026 Tian Tong Hua Lu in the Karma Palace: Mental Ease for Sleep and Mood, While Guarding Against Indulgence
enDesc: With Tian Tong Hua Lu in the Karma Palace, the mind relaxes and contentment comes more easily, helping sleep and emotional recovery; use that ease as stamina rather than escape, guarding against indulgence that lets comforts wear down drive.
cnDesc: 天同化禄落福德，这一年精神松、容易知足，利睡眠与情绪恢复；关键是把放松用成续航而非逃避，防沉溺安逸、兴趣消磨斗志。

cnTitle: 2026天机化权在命宫：谋略决断增强，防算得太精、刚愎
enTitle: 2026 Tian Ji Hua Quan in the Life Palace: Sharper Strategy and Decisiveness, While Guarding Against Overcalculation and Stubbornness
enDesc: With Tian Ji Hua Quan in the Life Palace, thinking, decisiveness and control strengthen this year and what you want can be moved; use the intelligence to execute, guarding against stubbornness, overcalculation and too-frequent change.
cnDesc: 天机化权落命宫，这一年动脑、决断与掌控力都增强，想做的事能推动；关键是把聪明用于落实，防刚愎自用、算过头和变动太频。

cnTitle: 2026天机化权在财帛宫：靠策划动脑进财，防算过头、钱不安稳
enTitle: 2026 Tian Ji Hua Quan in the Wealth Palace: Income Through Planning, While Guarding Against Overcalculation and Unsteady Money
enDesc: With Tian Ji Hua Quan in the Wealth Palace, income comes through planning, skill and thinking, and cash flow can improve when arranged well; land the plans and keep clear accounts, guarding against only calculating or overcalculating. This is not investment advice.
cnDesc: 天机化权落财帛，这一年靠策划、技术与动脑进财，现金流可因安排得当而改善；关键是方案落地、账目清楚，防只算不动或算过头（不构成投资建议）。

cnTitle: 2026天机化权在官禄宫：事业突破与改组，利技术统筹，防变动过频
enTitle: 2026 Tian Ji Hua Quan in the Career Palace: Breakthrough and Restructuring Favoring Technical Leadership, While Guarding Against Too Much Change
enDesc: With Tian Ji Hua Quan in the Career Palace, work brings breakthroughs, restructuring and promotion chances, favoring technical, coordinating and behind-the-scenes decision roles; carry reforms into results and guard against too much change that the team cannot follow.
cnDesc: 天机化权落官禄，这一年事业有突破、改组与升迁机会，利技术、统筹与幕后决策；关键是把改革落到成果，防变动过频、团队跟不上。

cnTitle: 2026天机化权在迁移宫：外部机会与奔波，利出差迁移，防劳损
enTitle: 2026 Tian Ji Hua Quan in the Travel Palace: Outside Opportunity and Movement Favoring Travel, While Guarding Against Strain
enDesc: With Tian Ji Hua Quan in the Travel Palace, outside opportunities abound and travel, relocation and outward expansion benefit, with adaptability opening new ground; pace the movement and guard against overwork, too much change and feeling unsupported away from home.
cnDesc: 天机化权落迁移，这一年外部机会多、利出差、搬迁与对外拓展，能靠应变打开局面；关键是把奔波安排出节奏，防过劳、变动太多和在外少援。

cnTitle: 盘上空宫多怎么读：不是处处空，而是分别借、逐个定
enTitle: How to Read a Chart With Many Empty Palaces: Not Empty Everywhere, but Borrowing and Confirming One by One
enDesc: Several palaces without major stars do not mean no support everywhere; each empty palace borrows from its opposite, reads its trine and the transformations that trigger it, and after confirming the chart the reading actually clarifies.
cnDesc: 多个宫位无主星，不代表处处无依；每个空宫分别借对宫、看三方与四化从哪被触发，再做一次定盘，思路反而清楚。

cnTitle: 盘上四化太多怎么抓重点：先分层，再分禄忌
enTitle: How to Find Focus When Many Transformations Appear: Layer First, Then Lu and Ji
enDesc: Natal, decade and year transformations can stack into a dozen or more; the way to focus is to layer by time first and then prioritize Lu and Ji, settling the main line before placing Quan, Ke and details.
cnDesc: 本命、大限、流年四化叠在一起动辄十几颗，抓重点的方法是先按时间分层、再按禄忌优先，先定主线，权科与细节往后放。

cnTitle: 一张盘怎么找本命主轴：这一生被什么牵引
enTitle: How to Find the Natal Main Thread: What Pulls This Life
enDesc: The natal main thread is the theme a life keeps returning to; extract it by combining the natal transformations with the Life-Wealth-Career trine, settling the long line first and then using the decades to see where it unfolds.
cnDesc: 本命主轴看的是这一生反复围绕的主题，方法是把生年四化与命财官三合合起来提炼，先定长期主线，再交给大限看它在哪个阶段展开。

cnTitle: 大限流年定了年份，流月流日怎么把应期定到月到日
enTitle: After Decade and Year Set the Year, How Monthly and Daily Stars Pin Timing to Month and Day
enDesc: The decade and year first place an event in a given year, then monthly transformations narrow it to a month and daily stems narrow it to a day; the finer layers only fine-tune and must not reverse the main verdict.
cnDesc: 大限、流年先把事件定到某一年，再用流月四化收窄到月份、流日干支收窄到日子；越细的层级越只做微调，不能反过来主导吉凶。

cnTitle: 怎么判断一张盘的高低层次：不看单颗星，看净组合
enTitle: How to Judge a Chart Overall Level: Not One Star, but the Net Combination
enDesc: A chart level does not depend on owning a certain auspicious star but on major-star brightness, the net triple-direction combination and whether transformations form a pattern; read the overall structure before individual palace strength.
cnDesc: 盘的高低不取决于有没有某颗吉星，而看主星庙旺、三方四正净组合与四化能否成格；先看整体结构，再谈单宫强弱。

cnTitle: 看盘先看大限还是先看流年：本命为体，大限先于流年
enTitle: Read the Decade or the Year First: Natal as the Base, Decade Before Year
enDesc: The right order is natal as the base, then the decade to set the ten-year tone, then the year to set that year trigger; skipping the decade to read the year makes short-term fluctuation look like long-term direction.
cnDesc: 正确顺序是本命为体、先大限定十年底色、再流年定当年触发；跳过十年直接看流年，容易把短期波动误当成长期方向。

cnTitle: 十四主星怎么记最快：分组加对星，比死背顺序牢
enTitle: How to Memorize the Fourteen Major Stars Fast: Groups and Pairs Beat Rote Order
enDesc: Group the fourteen major stars by leading, pioneering, managing, strategizing and serving, then link them through pairs such as Sun-Moon and Treasury-Minister; remembering functional roles is far faster than reciting order.
cnDesc: 把十四主星按领导、开创、理财、智谋、服务分组，再用太阳太阴、天府天相等对星串起来，记住功能分工比背顺序快得多。

cnTitle: 怎么理解星曜靠组合而非单星：一颗星会随同伴变意思
enTitle: How to Understand Stars Through Combination, Not Alone: One Star Changes Meaning With Its Company
enDesc: The same star changes meaning across palaces, companions and transformations; building a star-plus-palace-plus-transformation reading is far more accurate than memorizing isolated star verdicts.
cnDesc: 同颗星落不同宫、遇不同同伴和四化，含义会明显变化；先建立「星+宫+化」的组合读法，比孤立背单星判语准确得多。

cnTitle: 英星入庙格怎么看：破军在子午入庙，危中建功、先破后立
enTitle: The Ying Xing Ru Miao Pattern: Po Jun Exalted at Zi or Wu, Building Through Crisis
enDesc: Po Jun exalted in the Life Palace at Zi or Wu forms Ying Xing Ru Miao, showing someone who dares to break a stale order and builds through difficulty; it still needs Lu and auspicious stars, and a fallen Po Jun with malefics does not form the pattern.
cnDesc: 破军在子、午宫入庙守命为英星入庙，主敢于破旧局、在难处建功、先破后立；仍要见禄与吉星，落陷加煞则不成，不能见破军就套格。

cnTitle: 紫微、天府型的人配什么伴侣：懂掌控、也给稳定的人
enTitle: What Partners Suit Zi Wei and Tian Fu Types: Someone Who Understands Control and Gives Stability
enDesc: Zi Wei values control and dignity while Tian Fu values stability and accumulation; both suit steady, emotionally grounded partners who understand their lead, have their own confidence and do not fight for control head-on, where being understood matters more than being challenged.
cnDesc: 紫微重掌控与面子、天府重稳定与积累，这两类人适合能理解其主导感、情绪稳定、有自己底气又不正面争主导的伴侣，相处重在被理解而非被顶撞。

cnTitle: 武曲、贪狼型的人配什么伴侣：落地务实、又不被绑死的人
enTitle: What Partners Suit Wu Qu and Tan Lang Types: Grounded and Practical, Yet Not Tied Down
enDesc: Wu Qu is practical and result-focused while Tan Lang is versatile and loves novelty; both suit partners who ground daily life with principles yet give room and do not tie the relationship down, where the balance of practicality and freedom matters.
cnDesc: 武曲务实重结果、贪狼多才爱新鲜，这两类人适合既能把日子落地、讲原则，又给彼此空间、不把关系绑死的伴侣，相处重在务实与自由的平衡。

cnTitle: 太阳、太阴型的人配什么伴侣：明暗互补、情绪节奏同频
enTitle: What Partners Suit Sun and Moon Types: Complementary Light and Shade with Matching Emotional Rhythm
enDesc: The Sun is outward and warm, giving and illuminating, while the Moon is inward and sensitive, feeling and caring; they suit partners who complement light and shade, share emotional rhythm and hold each other, where being responded to matters more than one-way giving.
cnDesc: 太阳外放热情、主付出与照亮，太阴内敛细腻、主感受与照顾；适合明暗互补、情绪节奏同频、能彼此承接的伴侣，相处重在被回应而非单向付出。

cnTitle: 杀破狼型的人配什么伴侣：接得住变化、各自独立的人
enTitle: What Partners Suit Sha-Po-Lang Types: Someone Who Handles Change and Stays Independent
enDesc: Qi Sha, Po Jun and Tan Lang carry strong change, fast rhythm and a love of reshaping; they suit independent partners who handle change, keep their own life focus and do not depend on the other for stability, where moving side by side matters more than binding each other.
cnDesc: 七杀、破军、贪狼变动性强、节奏快、爱折腾，适合内心独立、接得住变化、有自己生活重心、不依赖对方安定的伴侣，相处重在并肩而行而非互相捆绑。

cnTitle: 旧情复合能不能长久：看当初分开的问题解没解决
enTitle: Can a Reconciled Relationship Last: Whether the Original Problem Was Actually Solved
enDesc: Whether reconciliation lasts depends not on love alone but on whether the structural problem that caused the split was solved, whether both genuinely changed, and whether the decade Spouse line is still activated; diagnose the problem before discussing return.
cnDesc: 复合会不会长久，不取决于还爱不爱，而看当初导致分开的结构性问题是否被解决、双方是否真的改变，以及大限夫妻线是否仍在引动，先辨问题再谈回头。

cnTitle: 异地长距感情怎么看：看信任、节奏与团聚的时间窗
enTitle: How to Read Long-Distance Relationships: Trust, Rhythm and the Window to Reunite
enDesc: Long-distance relationships are read through the Spouse Palace, Travel Palace, Tian Ma and transformations, focusing on trust, communication rhythm and a clear window to reunite; distance itself does not decide success, but no visible end is what drains people.
cnDesc: 异地感情看夫妻宫、迁移宫与天马、四化，重点是信任基础、沟通节奏和有没有明确的团聚时间窗；距离本身不决定成败，看不到头才消耗人。

cnTitle: 成年后怎么和父母相处：从被照顾转到有边界的互相照顾
enTitle: How to Relate to Parents in Adulthood: From Being Cared For to Boundaried Mutual Care
enDesc: The adult relationship with parents is read through the Parents Palace and decades, shifting from being arranged by them to separate, boundaried mutual care; making respect, boundaries and responsibility clear actually brings you closer.
cnDesc: 成年后与父母的关系要看父母宫与大限，重心从「被父母安排」转到「各自独立、有边界地照顾」；把尊重、边界和责任讲清楚，反而更亲。

cnTitle: 疾厄宫怎么看：看体质倾向，不是给自己下诊断
enTitle: How to Read the Health Palace: Constitutional Tendencies, Not a Self-Diagnosis
enDesc: The Health Palace shows constitutional leanings and the systems most likely to bear strain; combined with major stars, transformations and timing, it only flags areas to watch. Health discomfort is a tendency, not a diagnosis, and formal medical care always takes precedence.
cnDesc: 疾厄宫看的是体质偏性与容易承压的系统，结合主星、四化与大限流年，只提示要留意的方向；身体不适是倾向非诊断，务必以正规就医为准。

cnTitle: 兄弟宫怎么看：手足、同辈，以及合伙借贷的边界
enTitle: How to Read the Siblings Palace: Siblings, Peers, and the Boundaries of Partnership and Lending
enDesc: The Siblings Palace governs siblings, peers and the bond over cash reserves, touching the resource boundaries of partnership and lending; warmth and rules must be kept separate, and any lending or cooperation relies on a qualified lawyer, proper channels and a written contract.
cnDesc: 兄弟宫管手足、同辈与现金存量的缘分，也旁及合伙、借贷的资源边界；有情义与讲规则要分开，凡借贷合作以专业律师、正规途径和书面合同为准。

cnTitle: 福德宫怎么看：一个人内心快不快乐、会不会内耗
enTitle: How to Read the Karma Palace: Inner Happiness and Whether the Mind Drains Itself
enDesc: The Karma Palace governs the mental world, emotional patterns and resilience as the baseline of inner happiness; reading its major star, transformations and trine shows whether someone is content or prone to inner drain and how to nourish the mind.
cnDesc: 福德宫管精神世界、情绪模式与恢复力，是内心快乐的底色；看主星、四化与三方，能看出一个人是知足常乐还是容易内耗，以及该怎么养心。

cnTitle: 指背在命宫怎么看：易被背后议论，把敏感活成坦荡
enTitle: Zhi Bei in the Life Palace: Easily Talked About, Turning Sensitivity Into Open Strength
enDesc: Zhi Bei governs behind-the-back criticism, misunderstanding and small disturbances to reputation; in the Life Palace it brings strong intuition and concern with judgment. Use that sensitivity for self-reflection and real ability, and by acting with integrity and explaining less, the talk falls flat.
cnDesc: 指背主背后非议、被人误会与名声上的小扰动，落命宫的人直觉强、在意评价；关键是把敏感用成自省与实力，行得正、少靠解释，议论自然落空。

cnTitle: 桃花星会聚怎么看：人缘魅力强，分清人缘、桃花与正缘
enTitle: When Romance Stars Gather: Strong Charm, and the Need to Tell Popularity, Attraction and the Right Person Apart
enDesc: When romance stars such as Hong Luan, Tian Xi, Xian Chi and Tian Yao meet, they bring strong popularity, charm and many chances; the key is separating good connections, draining flirtation and the right partner, guarding against ambiguous attachments and moving relationships toward clarity and responsibility.
cnDesc: 红鸾、天喜、咸池、天姚等桃花星同会，主人缘好、魅力强、机会多；关键是分清「好人缘、烂桃花、正缘」三件事，防暧昧损耗，关系要落到明确与负责。

cnTitle: 2026丙午年换工作时机：天机化权主变动，先看大限再动身
enTitle: Changing Jobs in the 2026 Bing Wu Year: Tian Ji Hua Quan Drives Change, Check the Decade Before Moving
enDesc: In 2026 Tian Ji Hua Quan drives career change and restructuring while Lian Zhen Hua Ji warns of workplace friction; before changing jobs, read the decade and Career main line, prepare cash flow and then choose a year-or-month window, avoiding impulsive resignation. This is not career or investment advice.
cnDesc: 2026 天机化权主事业变动与改组、廉贞化忌防人际背刺，换工作要先看大限与官禄主线、备好现金流，再挑流年流月的窗口，忌裸辞冲动（不构成职业与投资建议）。

cnTitle: 财务纠纷怎么处理：先看清分歧来源，再走正规途径留证据
enTitle: How to Handle Financial Disputes: See the Source of Disagreement, Then Use Proper Channels and Keep Evidence
enDesc: Financial disputes can be read through the Wealth, Siblings and Property transformations to see whether disagreement centers on money, relationships or assets; in practice rely on a qualified lawyer, proper channels and written evidence, negotiating with rules first rather than fighting on emotion.
cnDesc: 财务纠纷可从财帛、兄弟、田宅的四化看分歧多发生在钱、人情还是资产上；现实处理以专业律师、正规途径和书面证据为准，先协商、讲规则，不靠斗气。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数能看寿命吗：看的是健康倾向，不是具体寿数
enTitle: Can Zi Wei Dou Shu Read Longevity: It Shows Health Tendencies, Not a Fixed Lifespan
enDesc: A Zi Wei chart can read constitutional leanings and resilience through the Health Palace, Karma Palace and decades to flag health directions, but it cannot and should not assert a fixed lifespan; all health matters rely on formal medical care.
cnDesc: 紫微盘能从疾厄、福德与大限看体质偏性和恢复力，提示该留意的健康方向，但不能、也不应断言具体寿命；健康问题一律以正规就医为准。
